newsitem.title: USA: Oneita fiscal Q4 shr loss $2.56 vs loss $0.40.
newsitem.headline: Oneita fiscal Q4 shr loss $2.56 vs loss $0.40.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Full company name is Oneita Industries Inc.
Company said Q4 loss due to selling price decreases, inventory write-downs and lower production volume.
It also said it was not in compliance with "certain" financial covenants regarding a revolving credit agreement and a loan agreement with an institutional lender.
Company said there was a $29 million collateral shortfall under the agreements relating to its borrowing capacity.

It said it was discussing ways to secure waivers covering the periods of non-compliance, revise certain financial covenants and extend collateral under the agreement. Company said it will also remain in default under $7.5 million principal amount of promissory notes issued to its chairman.
